name: Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering
definition: A compute shader technique that generates anisotropic voxel representations for cone tracing by averaging alpha-blended texels from 2x2x2 voxel blocks across six face directions.
summary: Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering prevents light leaks by storing six directional voxel copies instead of isotropic averages, preserving directional occlusion for thin geometry.
